title: Password reset link can be reused
description: The password reset link still works after it has already been used once so anyone with the old email can reset the password again later

title: Double booking on appointment slot
description: Two patients can book the same appointment slot at the same time and both get a confirmation

title: Session stays logged in after logout
description: After clicking logout the back button returns to the dashboard still logged in with the session active

title: Lab results PDF downloads blank
description: Downloading the lab results PDF produces a blank file with no content for some patients

title: Search returns other patients
description: Typing a partial name in patient search shows patients from other clinics in the results list

title: Timezone shifts appointment time
description: Appointments booked in the evening display one hour earlier after daylight saving changes

title: Upload fails for large scans
description: Uploading a scanned document larger than ten megabytes fails with a generic error and no retry option

title: Medication list prints without doses
description: The printed medication list omits the dose and frequency columns that appear on screen
